- CSP-safe saved-theme startup restores the chosen theme without allowing inline scripts.
- Premium theme-aware login: six locally bundled architectural artworks, clear form surfaces, compact branding, 44px controls and responsive layouts. Shop keeps its existing five selectable themes.

Release metadata is signed for the existing verified update channel."}
